## 4-Tier Competitive Commercial Offerings ("Get-to-the-Client-First")
- **Tier 1 — Executive AI Consultation (Free 15-Min Triage Call OR $99 Full 60-Min Department AI Efficiency Audit, normally $500)**:
  - Comprehensive operational bottleneck analysis, manual payroll waste calculation, and actionable custom AI implementation roadmap.
  - Includes a **Free 48-Hour Live AI Voice/Workflow Prototype** customized for the client's business.
  - **Zero-Risk Dollar Guarantee**: Guaranteed to uncover at least **$2,500+/month ($30,000/year)** in manual payroll savings that can be automated immediately, or the client pays **$0** (100% of the $99 is credited toward any solution or training).
- **Tier 2 — Corporate AI Staff Bootcamp ($497 Half-Day Team Workshop, normally $1,500)**:
  - Hands-on workforce training for up to 15 existing staff members (on-site in South Florida or live virtual, English & Spanish).
  - Role-specific AI workflows, enterprise data privacy guardrails, and custom Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) so **1 AI-trained employee produces the output of 5**.
- **Tier 3 — Custom AI Solution & 24/7 Agent ($997 Turnkey Build OR $297/mo All-Inclusive Managed AI — Most Popular)**:
  - 14-day turnkey deployment of a **24/7 Bilingual AI Voice & Web Receptionist (JAss)** or 1 high-impact automated intake, CRM, or billing workflow.
- **Tier 4 — Full Enterprise AI Transformation ($4,900 – $15,000+)**:
  - End-to-end engineering of autonomous multi-agent pipelines, custom CRMs, computer vision systems, and EHR/ERP integrations, plus Corporate AI Staff Bootcamp included free.

## Living Proof-of-Work: 21 Production AI Systems & Case Studies
Full interactive architecture catalog: https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects

### Healthcare & Clinical AI
- [PocketScribe — Ambient AI Medical Scribe](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/ai-medical-scribe-pocketscribe): Multi-speaker clinical consultation capture to structured SOAP notes and ICD-10/CPT billing codes (https://pocketscribe.online).
- [Medical Billing & RCM Automation](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/medical-billing-rcm-automation): Automated insurance verification, prior authorization, and claim scrubbing reducing denials by 40%+.
- [Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/remote-patient-monitoring): Continuous biometric telemetry and clinical alert triage.
- [Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM)](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/remote-therapeutic-monitoring): Computer-vision physical therapy adherence and kinematic recovery tracking.
- [Clinical Movement & Ataxia Assessment](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/clinical-movement-ataxia-assessment): Quantitative neurological motor control and gait assessment via computer vision.

### Construction, AEC & Spatial Computer Vision
- [3D Room Mapping & Spatial AI](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/3d-room-mapping-spatial-ai): LiDAR and multi-view photogrammetry to CAD-ready floor plans and volumetric takeoffs.
- [Room Defect Monitoring & Inspection AI](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/room-defect-monitoring-ai): Automated crack, moisture, and structural defect localization for contractors and property managers.
- [Architectural Modular & Millwork Commerce System](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/modular-commerce-system): Architectural cabinet/millwork specification and automated quoting engine.

### Real Estate, Legal & Professional Services
- [24/7 Bilingual AI Voice Receptionist (JAss)](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/ai-voice-receptionist): Sub-second voice agent answering phone calls, qualifying leads, and booking calendars in English and Spanish.
- [Estate Match & RealEstateDates Intelligence](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/estate-match-real-estate-ai): Automated real estate contract deadline calculators, escrow tracking, and buyer-property matching (https://realestatedates.com).
- [CRM & Revenue Operations Automation](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/crm-revenue-automation): Speed-to-lead qualification, WhatsApp/SMS sequences, and multi-channel pipeline orchestration.
- [AI Chatbots & Digital Assistants](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/ai-chatbots-digital-assistants): RAG-grounded enterprise knowledge assistants with deterministic guardrails.

### Sports Science & Biomechanics
- [JMM — Jas Miami Method Performance Platform](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/jmm-jas-miami-method): AI-driven endurance coaching, metabolic zone modeling, and athlete telemetry (https://jasmiamimethod.fit).
- [RunForm — Running Gait Biomechanics](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/runform-running-biomechanics): 60fps smartphone pose estimation computing joint angles, cadence, and ground contact time.
- [Cycling Bike-Fit Kinematic Analysis](https://www.aidynamic.pro/projects/cycling-bike-fit-analysis): Markerless computer vision saddle, knee-extension, and aerodynamic posture optimization.
